evd_title: GPT-4 Vision identified CONSORT flow diagrams with 100% accuracy but detected missing participant details at only 57% accuracy
finding: GPT-4 Vision identified CONSORT flow diagrams with 100% accuracy but detected missing participant details at only 57% accuracy
P: 20 flow-diagram images (10 CONSORT, 10 distractors) from Schulz et al. dataset RCTs, TRAIN+TEST
I: GPT-4 Vision, zero-shot, Base64 image + same system prompt
C: Schulz et al. labels (Q10) and author labels (Q11)
O: Flow diagram identified: F1 1.0, acc 100% (89-100%); missing loss/exclusion reasons: F1 0.58, acc 57% (39-73%)
T: Papers published 2020; GPT-4 Vision used on/before May 2024; paper 2025
